summary.name: CodeTrendy
summary.one_liner: CodeTrendy is a curated directory for discovering newly launched startups, SaaS tools, and indie products, where makers can submit listings and buy featured placement.
use_cases: Discover newly launched startups and SaaS tools
Submit a product to get listed in a curated directory
Buy featured or homepage placement for a launch
Find alternatives to a listed product
Let AI assistants search tool listings via MCP
summary.what_it_does: The site is a curated directory of newly launched startups, SaaS tools, and indie products, with each listing screened and organized by category. Makers can get a free curated profile or pay for placement tiers that add a Verified Business badge, category pins, homepage visibility, and featured sidebar spotlight. Listings are described as permanent, and credit packs (10 for $149, 25 for $299, 100 for $899) can be spent across tiers for bulk submissions. The page also mentions a free, read-only remote MCP server at codetrendy.com/api/mcp that lets AI assistants search listings, read profiles, and find alternatives without an API key.
notable: Free read-only remote MCP server (no API key) for AI assistants to search listings and find alternatives
Free curated profile option; paid tiers add Verified Business badge, featured placement, or homepage visibility
Credit packs allow bulk submissions with one prepaid balance; rejected listings refund credits
Downloadable public CSV and audited directory snapshot
caveats: Paid placement tiers cost money; unpaid listings are publicly shown as Unverified and go live at least 7 days after submission
Featured placement and some tiers are paid and some are subscriptions billed monthly after a 24-hour free trial, cancellable anytime
Featured placement is removed immediately upon cancellation
